nodes.natural_language: Inductive step: replace a_{n-2},a_{n-1} by a_{n-2}a_{n-1} and 1; the product remains 1 and the sum does not increase.
nodes.statement: If a_{n-1}>=1>=a_{n-2} then (a_{n-2}a_{n-1},1) has the same product and smaller or equal sum compared with (a_{n-2},a_{n-1}).

nodes.natural_language: By the AM-GM inequality the arithmetic mean of a_0,… ,a_{n-1} is at least the geometric mean, which equals 1, and the claimed inequality follows at once.
The theorem follows by induction together with the AM-GM inequality.
nodes.statement: For any real-valued function a on the natural numbers such that \forall i \in ℕ, a_i \ge 0, if \prod_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i = 1, then \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i \ge n.
